offerings.name: Governance Assessment
offerings.customer_outcome: A source- and evidence-bound map of an existing workflow, its authoritative states, decision boundaries, allowed transitions, failure conditions, and a governed target-state implementation plan.
excluded: claim that repository or CI success establishes runtime governance
offerings.authority_boundary: ICV may analyze and package governance requirements; authoritative customer, StegVerse, legal, operational, credential, execution, and release decisions remain with their applicable owners.

offerings.name: Admitted Code
offerings.customer_outcome: A bounded determination of what code is being proposed, what it is allowed to affect, what evidence is required before admission, and what receipt/evidence must exist before any governed execution claim.
excluded: production admission runtime unless separately released and authorized
claim that current ICV gateway source candidates are released commercial artifacts
offerings.authority_boundary: Current ICV gateway work is source/test evidence, not a released admission authority. A production Admitted Code service requires separately authorized runtime, distribution, trust-root, and custody conditions.

offerings.name: StegCRM
offerings.customer_outcome: A governed commercial relationship projection across existing CRM, campaign, email, repository, and operational sources without forcing those systems to surrender source authority.
excluded: automatic replacement of customer CRM authority
production customer deployment implied solely by internal StegOps proof
offerings.authority_boundary: StegCRM may project and reconcile customer commercial state; source systems retain their declared authority unless a separately admitted transition explicitly changes ownership.
